_about: Words for the Guild app: the daily card (/today/), the journal (/journal/), the install help in the footer, and the offline page. Drafts for Ryan to rewrite. The app itself is the website, installable: see tools/app_page.py.
name: Chaotic Good Guild
app_description: Mira's card for today, readings for reflection, the Guild calendar and the moon, and a private journal that stays on your device.

today.title: Mira's card for today
today.desc: One card from Mira each day, to carry with you. Draw it, sit with it, and come back tomorrow for another.
today.idle: Mira shuffles once, slowly, and sets a single card face down for you. Touch the deck when you're ready.
today.drawn: Carry this one with you today. Tomorrow, there'll be another.
today.note_prompt: What stands out to you about this card today?

journal.title: Your Journal
journal.desc: The readings you've kept, and what you made of them. Your journal lives only on this device: nothing here is sent anywhere, and nobody but you can read it.
journal.empty: Nothing kept yet. Draw today's card, or ask Mira for a reading, and keep the ones that speak to you.
prompts: What felt true, and what didn't?
What will you do with this?
journal.fine: Clearing your browser's data for this site clears your journal too. Download a copy now and then if you'd like to keep it.

keep.full: Your journal couldn't save this. Your browser may be blocking storage for this site.

install.title: Bring the Guild home
install.lede: Put the Guild on your home screen or desktop: its own icon, its own window, a card from Mira each day, and most of the village works even without a connection.
install.ios: On iPhone or iPad, open this page in Safari, tap the Share button, then choose Add to Home Screen.
install.android: In Chrome, open the menu (the three dots) and choose Install app, or Add to Home screen.
install.mac_safari: In Safari, open the File menu and choose Add to Dock.
install.firefox: Firefox can't install sites as apps. Open chaoticgoodguild.com in Chrome, Edge or Safari, and install it from there.
install.desktop: Look for the install icon at the right end of the address bar, or open the browser menu and choose Install.
install.done: Welcome home. The Guild is on your device now.
